newsitem.title: USA: US stocks mixed, nearly unchanged in heavy volume.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mixed, nearly unchanged in heavy volume.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were steady, nearly unchanged at Friday's opening amid massive volume from the triple-witching expiry options and futures.
The New York Stock Exchange had volume of 87.4 million. The smaller Nasdaq system recorded volume of 25.2 million.
The Dow Jones industrials average was off one at 5866.
The long bond yielded 1/32 less at 7.05 percent.
